domains.name: Monitoring, Logging, Analysis, Remediation, and Performance Optimization

tasks.name: Implement metrics, alarms, and filters by using AWS monitoring and logging services.

concepts.name: Amazon CloudWatch
concepts.description: AWS observability service for metrics, logs, alarms, dashboards, and related operational signals.

concepts.name: CloudWatch metrics

concepts.name: CloudWatch agent

concepts.name: CloudWatch alarms
concepts.description: Rules that evaluate metrics, expressions, or supported queries and change state when conditions are met.

concepts.name: CloudWatch composite alarms
concepts.description: Alarms that combine the states of other alarms with Boolean logic to reduce alert noise.

concepts.name: CloudWatch Logs metric filters
concepts.description: Filters that turn matching log events into CloudWatch metric data.

concepts.name: CloudWatch metric math

concepts.name: CloudWatch dashboards

concepts.name: Alarm actions and notifications

questions.prompt: A CloudWatch alarm changed to ALARM, but the on-call engineer received no email. Work through the most useful diagnosis, remediation, and verification path.

steps.prompt: The alarm is definitely in ALARM. What should you establish first?

choices.label: Check alarm history to confirm the SNS action is enabled and was attempted on the state transition
Inspect EC2 CPUUtilization even though the alarm state is already known
Delete and recreate the alarm before checking its action configuration
Inspect Cost Explorer for the notification period

steps.prompt: Alarm history shows the SNS action was invoked. Which next check best isolates the notification failure?

choices.label: Inspect the SNS topic/subscription endpoint status and delivery information, including whether an email subscription is confirmed
Create a new CloudWatch dashboard
Review all CloudTrail events regardless of service or time
Increase the alarm threshold so it returns to OK

steps.prompt: The email subscription is PendingConfirmation. What fixes the actual problem?

choices.label: Confirm the SNS email subscription (or replace it with a valid confirmed endpoint)
Create a second alarm with the same SNS topic
Enable EC2 detailed monitoring
Change the alarm period without changing the subscription

steps.prompt: The subscription is now confirmed, but the alarm is still in its original ALARM state. What verification is most direct?

choices.label: Publish a controlled SNS test message; verify the alarm separately on its next state transition
Wait for CloudWatch to resend the same alarm action continuously while the state remains ALARM
Delete the SNS topic and wait for an error
Inspect unrelated S3 access logs

questions.explanation: First prove the alarm attempted its configured action. Then inspect SNS. A `PendingConfirmation` email subscription does not receive messages. After fixing it, use a controlled SNS test. Alarm actions occur on state transitions, so an alarm that stays in ALARM does not continuously resend the action.
hints: Treat this as a dependency chain: alarm action → SNS topic → confirmed subscription → endpoint delivery.
